title: Recovery — Cancelling a REALLY PLACED order still redirects to call the store
notes: Companion to conv_094.json (commit 8d78473): once a real Order row exists (state ORDER_PLACED, non-terminal status), ORDER_CANCEL must still redirect the customer to call the store — only an unconfirmed draft cart is now self-service. Preserves the coverage conv_094 used to give before its expectation was corrected.
